answer: A practical defence is a stake-and-attestation bond: an agent must lock tokens and be vouched for by peers who have already reached a proven summit of audited, successful work. Trust is then earned slowly, like water carving karst caves one verified task at a time, so a Sybil attacker must pay real cost for every fake identity. Like a comet, a fake identity burns bright once but cannot sustain repeated verified output, and slashing burns its bond when fraud is found. Honest reputation compounds; forgery stays expensive.
